common_word_offer.plain_meaning: what satisfies the written description / that which ...
common_word_offer.core: For each explicitly declared sort T, a written predicate P:T->Truth yields a nominal description D:T->Truth with D(x)=P(x). This closes a written description for use as a nominal constituent; it does not supply P or invent x.
common_word_offer.explicit_cost: Description formation, actual reference anchoring, definite/existential/universal force, and explanatory linkage are distinct paid contributions. The core alone is not a noun, an assertion, a cause or a participant introduction.
common_word_offer.domain_generality: The same predicate-to-description contribution may be hypothesized over written material, person/kind or event predicates. Sort and predicate must already be written under a declared whole construction; no Wind-to-Water, Event-to-Property, Spec-to-Frame or Kind-to-Instance cast.
common_word_offer.anaphoric_consumer: A separately paid THAT(id,D) construction checks the written prior participant satisfies D and preserves its identity. No latest-anything fallback or identification across unpaid text.
common_word_offer.restrictive_consumer: A separately paid EACH/ANY/NONE construction ranges over D and supplied source/domain scope; it contributes quantifier force instead of hiding a full proposition in D.
common_word_offer.causal_consumer: An explanation construction takes written propositions with their asserted, reported or hypothesized commitment; a nominal event reference is not automatically a true explanatory proposition.
common_word_offer.negative_controls: An empty/unwritten P gives no interpretation; free name lookup with no predicate cannot use the closure; two satisfying individuals are not collapsed by an unstated definite uniqueness rule.
common_word_offer.whole_residual_limit: Finite exact whole licenses and entry contexts remain required. A residual that contains an entire historical claim removes the proposed shared contribution and earns no composition credit.
common_word_offer.warning: This is a concrete prospective meaning family, not a recovered aN gloss. The three source traditions do not demonstrate the same lexeme or source language. No universal occurrence-wise type switch is licensed.

opportunities.name: Event nominal reference versus explanatory proposition
opportunities.whole_source_unit: Megenberg II25 complete owned chapter; focal complete opening generation/perception block91.14–92.10, before stone-identity objection. Remaining chapter stays available and is not claimed translated.
opportunities.historical_layer: Medieval natural-philosophy work via cached TITUS/Pfeiffer1861 electronic extraction; literal chapter boundary independently checked, no new manuscript collation.
exact_source_anchors: 91.28–30: aber daz reizen, daz der dunst tuot ... daz haizt der tonr
92.3–6: daz ist dar umb, daz ... dark/thick clouds extinguish flames, therefore thunder is heard without visible lightning
92.7–10: remote ignition/attenuated report explains seeing lightning without hearing thunder
complete_focal_content: Warm light fatty vapour rises toward the cold cloud region, is driven back repeatedly, then hurled downward rapidly and ignites in flight.
Its flames are named lightning; the rending it does in clouds/air is named thunder. The two therefore occur together in the account.
Sight precedes hearing because the visual sense reaches farther/faster; a washing/beating example illustrates that order.

The objection that one is sometimes perceived without the other gets two explanations: cloud darkness/thickness quenches the flame for invisible lightning; remote ignition prevents the sound reaching the observer.
real_predicates: REND(e,vapour,clouds/air) identifies the nominal event subsequently named thunder; NAME(e,thunder) does not identify the material vapour with the event.
DARK_THICK(clouds) and EXTINGUISH(clouds,flames) explain HEAR(thunder) with NOT_SEE(lightning).
REMOTE(ignition,observer) and NOT_REACH(sound,observer) explain SEE(lightning) with NOT_HEAR(thunder).
opportunities.possible_shared_contribution: Close the written rending predicate as an event description, then anchor the event for naming. Separately resume a whole written explanation proposition with its assertion scope. This supplies nominal referent content beyond an opaque record identifier.
changing_consequences: Replacing event e with material vapour changes what is named thunder, even though agent/material participants stay fixed.
Swapping the two explanation arguments reverses which perception is absent: thick clouds account for absent seeing, remoteness for absent hearing.
Causal co-occurrence does not entail both senses perceive both phenomena. Preserve observer and perception predicates.
source_limits: The sense-speed and generation claims are historical source assertions, not modern physical measurements.
daz, dar umb and English that/because are different constructions; their source wording does not establish one cross-domain lexeme.
No universal every-aN nominalizer, thunder noun, weather owner or manuscript acoustic alignment is chosen.
predecessors: IDEA000614 already owns three acoustic causes later in92.30–93.7; this offer is not another sound-triplet fit or reopening of its owned-acoustic-target gate.
IDEA000783/AB retains a whole causal draft but unknown intervening text cannot prove event identity; no latest-event rule is inherited.
IDEA000030 preserves that temporal sequencing may describe causally dependent worlds; matching the physical story cannot identify BECAUSE.
opportunities.next_opportunity: Only if root chooses this source account, write actual nominal predicate plus its separately scoped naming/explanation consumers in one complete owned unit. Compare material-versus-event and perception-scope alternatives without fetching targets or using the old thunder triplet as a selection device.

real_predicates: The queried set comprises prolonged sleeplessness, loose bowels and food deprivation for the same patient; ANY_ADMITTED in that written set reduces estimated danger.
Admission/report is not proof that the appearance actually arose from the admitted cause; the day-and-night course clarifies the proposed origin.
The paired none-reported and not-subsiding clauses precede severe prognosis, with their printed connective ambiguity retained.

A patient may confess a queried antecedent while the appearance is not in fact caused by it; changing report truth alone cannot silently establish the causal-origin proposition.
Adding new third/fourth-day signs does not change the identity of the repeated inquiry frame.
